name: Met Museum Art
description: Displays artworks from The Metropolitan Museum of Art's open collection. Browse by department, keyword search, or highlights gallery. No API key required.
author: Ryan Lane

fit_mode.title: Fit Mode
fit_mode.description: How to fit the artwork image to the display resolution

image_quality.title: Image Quality
image_quality.description: primary = full-resolution original, small = web-large thumbnail (faster)

cache_max_per_gallery.title: Max Artworks per Gallery
cache_max_per_gallery.description: How many artworks to cache per gallery (more = more variety, slower initial build)

refresh_interval_hours.title: Cache Refresh Interval (hours)
refresh_interval_hours.description: How often to re-fetch the artwork list from the Met API (default: weekly)

overlay_enabled.title: Bake Details onto Image
overlay_enabled.description: Draw title/artist/etc. directly onto the artwork image — useful when there's no paired details display

overlay_position.title: Overlay Position
overlay_position.description: Corner/edge where the baked-in details panel is drawn

overlay_fields.title: Overlay Fields
overlay_fields.description: Which artwork details to include in the baked-in overlay (same fields the paired details display uses). Text wraps to as many lines as needed — nothing is truncated.

overlay_font_scale.title: Overlay Text Size
overlay_font_scale.description: Relative size of the baked-in overlay text

overlay_font_family.title: Overlay Font
overlay_font_family.description: Typeface for the baked-in overlay text

include_metadata_in_response.title: Include Metadata in Response Header
include_metadata_in_response.description: Attach title/artist/date/etc. as a base64 X-Artwork-Metadata header on /request-image, so integrations (e.g. an MQTT payload) can read them without parsing the image

endpoints.description: Get a random artwork as raw image bytes
